test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Average of 12 numbers is 15. If a number 41 is also included, then what will be the average of these 13 numbers?
solution:
Average of numbers = Sum of numbers/ Total numbers

Average of first 12 numbers is 15

Sum of 12 numbers = 15 × 12 = 180

New number 41 is to be added

Average of 13 numbers = (Sum of 12 numbers + 13th number)/13

Average = (180 + 41)/13 = 221/13 = 17
